Supported Column Schema

Flexible matching: non-standard headers auto-map where possible. Numbers can be plain (1240000), compact ("1.2M", "600k"), or comma-separated ("1,240,000").

Core (Revenue)

track_title— Track / Song Titlerequired
month— Date / Monthrequired
revenue— Revenue / Earnings (USD)required
isrc— ISRC
artist— Primary Artist
platform— Platform / DSP
country— Country / Territory
streams— Streams / Plays

Attention (Optional · unlocks adjusted valuation)

tiktok_views— TikTok Views
tiktok_videos— TikTok Videos / Sound Uses
reels_uses— Instagram Reels Using Sound
youtube_views— YouTube + Shorts Views
shazam_count— Shazam Count
playlist_adds— Playlist Adds
